title: Spellforce Film Director
description: A woman in a blue jumpsuit stands in a dark, surreal basement holding a film projector in one hand and a glowing yellow object in the other, casting a beam of light. The scene is filled with hanging flowers dripping red liquid, film reels, VHS tapes, tacos, scattered sticky notes, a movie projector on a pedestal, and a sign reading 'SPELLFORCE SURREAL CINEMA VIDEOLAB'.
prompt: Surreal scene of a determined woman in a blue jumpsuit standing in a dark concrete basement, holding a film projector that casts a bright beam while gripping a glowing yellow object. Vines with purple flowers and white bleeding hearts dripping red liquid hang from the ceiling alongside film strips, tacos, and VHS tapes. Floor is covered in scattered film reels, broken bottles, sticky notes, and lime wedges. A vintage movie projector sits on a pedestal to her left. A sign on the wall reads SPELLFORCE SURREAL CINEMA VIDEOLAB. Dark, cinematic, and bizarre atmosphere.
